description_expanded: Description Description 30A beach house pet friendly rental Sanibel in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Sanibel is on the beach side of 30A and a mere 250 ft till your feet hit the sand! Pet Friendly Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Did we mention....Just 250 feet to the neighborhood walkover and the beautiful white sugar sands of the Gulf of Mexico? Families will enjoy the large living area and fully equipped kitchen along with the large decks on the 2nd & 3rd floor offer views of the gulf! This family friendly home sleeps up to 14 and enjoys a private community pool to which it shares with 9 homes. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * Seagrove Beach House * PET FRIENDLY * 5 Bedrooms * 5 Bathrooms * Large Living Area * Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Extensive Balconies with Gulf View * Master Bedroom w/King Bed & Full Sleeper Sofa * Master Bedroom w/Balcony * Master Bedroom w/Wet Bar & Mini Beverage Refrigerator * 2nd Bedroom w/Queen Bed * 3rd Bedroom w/2 Queen Beds * 4th Bedroom w/Queen Bed * 5th Bedroom w/Queen Bed * Washer/Dryer * FREE WI-FI * Sleeps 14 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT 30A - SEAGROVE BEACH, FLORIDA Seagrove Beach, Florida along 30A is the quintessential family friendly vacation spot and it is no wonder families return to here year after year! Families enjoy the ability to walk and bike everywhere. Family Friendly restaurants are abundant along with shopping. This home enjoys a fantastic location on the beachside of 30A and enjoys a community pool that serves 9 homes. Seaside is 2 miles from this home and 1.5 miles from the local Publix. COMMUNITY FEATURES COMMUNITY POOL ON THE BEACHSIDE OF 30A BEACH ACCESS - Tents are not allowed at this beach access point. SEAGROVE BEACH WALK & BIKE EVERYWHERE Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome well-trained non-shedding dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. Please no cats. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
